_comment: Scripted-scenario pack (Calradia Remembers). Each rule is a stateless reactive rule in the keyword DSL: when its trigger fires and its guards pass, its consequences mutate the world and its message is dropped into the world-event store (told in-game by rumor/chronicle). If several rules share a trigger, one is chosen at random. Triggers: ON_DEATH, ON_MARRIAGE, ON_WAR_DECLARED, ON_PEACE (the player or context hero/faction is matched by guards). Guards (AND-combined): IF_HERO_IS:<name>, IF_PLAYER_INVOLVED, IF_PLAYER_RULES, IF_PLAYER_IS_FEMALE/MALE, IF_PLAYER_AT_WAR:<faction>. Consequences: DECLARE_WAR:A,B  MAKE_PEACE:A,B  CHANGE_RELATION:HeroRef:+N. Test from console with: cr.scenario_fire ON_DEATH Rhagaea

rules.message: With the empress Rhagaea fallen, the eagles of the North and West turn upon a leaderless South.
